scope: fresh operational latent-slot memory; not a reproduction of the historical baseline

frozen_extraction.fact_query_source: existing O21A-MR frozen hidden cache: fact_H and query_H
frozen_extraction.candidate_b_entity_source: J3C-certified H_mention_fresh: exact entity mention mean hidden
frozen_extraction.cache_generation: not part of component training; no backbone forward in this phase

o21a_rebase.objective: retrieval CE + 0.5*batch-positive alignment CE + 0.1*(fact-entity CE + query-entity CE)

training.selection: best validation macro retrieval averaged over capacities 1,2,4

vgen2_rebase.architecture: OracleLocalCore: Linear(2048,64) content read + shared GRUCell(64,64); four slot-specific Linear(64,64) value heads
vgen2_rebase.write_output: updated target V_64; non-target slots bitwise unchanged
vgen2_rebase.read_output: 64-class logits from selected slot-specific value head

o3a_allocator_rebase.output: four free-slot logits; occupied slots masked as safety

candidate_b.feature_stats: use embedded train-only entity/relation mean and std; do not refit

router.write_flow: Candidate B on incoming entity/relation factors; UPDATE matched slot if frozen threshold passes, else NEW via O3a allocator
router.update_semantics: preserve the existing slot address and occupancy; update only its V state
router.read_flow: O21A Q-to-K retrieval among occupied slots; decode selected V

data_discipline.test_usage: final evaluation only after component and protocol freeze
data_discipline.feature_join: canonical fact ID / certified source row; never assume array order without an explicit join audit
data_discipline.normalization: O21A uses source-defined raw hidden features; Candidate B uses its frozen embedded train-only statistics

integration_mainline_gate.full_episode: report exact success rate and cascading-error breakdown; do not hide failures

stop_rule: If a rebuilt component fails its standalone gate, stop before training or integrating downstream components.
